name: determinants_features
description: Per-gene raw determinant features of the eligible genes, in §6.5 order; a feature NA in every row is dropped from the models (GIAP_SPEC.md §7.8.1, §7.8.3).

fields.name: abundance_log2
fields.description: log2 abundance (gene table); NA when not quantified

fields.name: ribosomal_protein
fields.description: Ribosomal protein (§7.1.2) or a CAI reference gene

fields.name: promotech_max
fields.description: Highest Promotech score upstream of the gene

fields.name: promotech_tu
fields.description: Promotech score of the TU promoter

fields.name: tx_rate_max_tu
fields.description: Highest Promoter Calculator rate of the TU

fields.name: tx_rate_sum_tu
fields.description: Summed Promoter Calculator rates of the TU

fields.name: n_promoters_tu_to_gene
fields.description: Promoter windows between the TU start and the gene

fields.name: tu_position
fields.description: Position of the gene in its TU, from 1

fields.name: dist_to_tu_start_bp
fields.description: Distance from the TU start to the start codon (bp)

fields.name: mrna_dg
fields.description: mRNA folding ΔG near the RBS (kcal/mol)

fields.name: gc3
fields.description: GC content at third codon positions

fields.name: in_bgc
fields.description: Gene in a biosynthetic gene cluster (C7/C8)

fields.name: gc_local_dev
fields.description: Local GC deviation from the replicon
